documents.content: DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm is a boutique hotel with 72 rooms across three categories, located in Berlin's Charlottenburg district. The hotel represents a balance between classical and modern design, offering individuality and minimalist style. The hotel is part of DORMERO Hotels, a group with over 60 properties across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Hungary, Spain, and Sri Lanka.

DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm is located at Eislebener Straße 14, 10789 Berlin, Germany. The hotel is just a few meters from the famous Kurfürstendamm boulevard, Berlin's premier shopping and entertainment district in Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf. The Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church is nearby.

Driving directions to DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm: From the A111 interstate, take the exit 'Wilmersdorf' and then the exit 'Kurfürstendamm'. When you get to the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church landmark, take a right turn into Rankestraße. After 200 meters, take a left turn into Eislebener Straße.

DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm has 72 rooms across three different categories. The rooms offer a perfect combination of design, individuality and minimalist style. All rooms feature exclusively developed DORMERO beds for optimal comfort, free WiFi, and a free minibar on arrival day.

The DORMERO Suite at Berlin Ku'damm is 65 square meters and features a spacious living and sleeping area, an en suite dressing room, and not only a bathroom but also a separate makeup room. It's our most luxurious accommodation option.

DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm offers 16 parking spaces in the underground parking garage. The daily parking rate is 25 EUR. Please note that it is not possible to reserve a parking space in advance - spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Free WiFi (WLAN) is available throughout the entire DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm. The use of the hotel WiFi is completely free of charge for all guests.
DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm offers a varied breakfast buffet daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Guests can add breakfast when booking online, by phone, or upon arrival at the hotel.
DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm has professional workout devices available for guests as part of its wellness and fitness amenities.
All rooms at DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm include a free minibar on arrival day. This is a complimentary amenity for all guests staying at the hotel.
All rooms at DORMERO Hotels feature exclusively developed DORMERO beds, designed for optimal comfort and a great night's sleep.

Check-in time at DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm is from 3:00 PM (15:00). Check-out time is by 12:00 PM (noon). The reception is staffed from 1:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The hotel offers easy check-in and fast check-out services.

DORMERO Hotels are pet-friendly! You can bring your favorite four-legged friend with you completely FREE of charge. Just mention when making your reservation that you'll be bringing a pet, and we'll make sure everything is ready for you both.
DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm is a non-smoking hotel. All rooms and common areas are smoke-free to ensure a comfortable environment for all guests.
DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm accepts digital payments only. All major credit and debit cards are accepted. Please note that cash payments are not available.
A Berlin city tax of 5% applies to overnight accommodations at DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm. Business travelers are exempt from this tax with appropriate documentation.

DORMERO Hotel Berlin Ku'damm contact information: Address: Eislebener Straße 14, 10789 Berlin, Germany. Phone: +49 30 202 13 300. Email: berlin@dormero.de. Central reservations: +49 30 20213300 (Monday-Friday 7am-7pm, Saturday-Sunday 10am-6pm) or reservierung@dormero.de.

DORMERO offers flexible rate options: The 'Smart Rate' offers flexibility with free cancellation. The 'Fancy Saver Rate' provides 15% savings with prepayment. Book directly on dormero.de for the best available rates.

DORMERO Hotels is a hotel group with over 60 properties across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Hungary, Spain, and Sri Lanka. The brand is known for combining classical and modern design, pet-friendly policies (pets stay FREE!), and consistent amenities including free WiFi, quality DORMERO beds, and breakfast buffets across all locations.

DORMERO Hotels prides itself on flexible and friendly service with 'flexible and sprightly' staff members. Most hotels have reception hours from 1 PM to 11 PM, while select cities including Frankfurt, Hanover, Stuttgart, and Vienna offer 24-hour reception service.
